description:
Create or increase a leveraged sBTC position (up to 1.5x) on your Pillar smart wallet. Opens the Pillar website Boost tab where you can set the amount and confirm. Your sBTC is supplied to Zest, borrowed against, and re-supplied for amplified Bitcoin exposure. For simple yield without leverage, use pillar_supply (Earn) instead. Amounts over 100,000 sats automatically enter DCA mode -- split into daily 100k-sat chunks (max 700k sats per schedule). The first chunk executes immediately, the rest follow daily.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

amount.description: Amount in satoshis to boost (optional, shown as suggestion)
